l0: L0: desk-checked (marker format CmdDispatcher.fpp NoOpStringReceived id 8; Version formats Version.fpp; SunCamMgr.fpp event formats); bench confirmation pending
deployment: SunCamRef (fprime-community/fprime-devices-reference), Linux aarch64 on the Pi 5 bench host, KissCAM V2 on /dev/ttyUSB0 (FTDI USB-RS422 FTAQMGVF), fprime-gds over TCP on the Pi

channels_note: suncam packet = the channels the component re-writes every 10th run tick (1 Hz) and on change (SDD §Behavior); 'bracket (2 suncam samples)' = wait for two further samples of every suncam channel (≥ 2 s). Camera-sourced channels (CameraMode, Exposure, ExposureReadback, CameraUptime, CameraValidCmds, CameraInvalidCmds, RegisterValue, LastCameraError) are written on reply only and are judged by last()/helpers or by delta() where two replies fall in the window.
checks_note: Every window's list opens with STD (declared with `require`: the completeness group) and closes with ABS (declared with `check`, like every other entry); the L3-1 R window requires only `both markers present` (no commands, two epochs) and checks ABS. Check names may repeat across the windows of one test; the QL shows the window beside each outcome.

not_covered_ack: REQ-004/016/018 timeout and failed-step paths: the bench camera answers and cannot be silenced (no power control); unit tests cover them

REQ-020 stray/malformed/late frames and the power-on line (SDD §Hardware notes, Power-on line; 21 unframed bytes): no second writer on the bus and a camera power cycle is performed only by the human on request; unit tests cover them (testMalformedAndStrayFrames, testPowerOnBanner)
REQ-021 mode mismatch while READY: needs a camera power-cycle; unit test
REQ-024 UART send failure and product allocation failure: not plantable without breaking the deployment; unit tests
REQ-028 exposure readback mismatch: the camera reads back what it stores; unit test
REQ-029 queue-full hooks: unreachable at 10 Hz / 115200 baud without a flood tool; unit tests
REQ-030 exact tick period: unit test; the quiet windows L0-1/L0-2 prove the periodic write on hardware
REQ-011 camera-refused push: not reachable now that EXPOSURE is range-checked locally; unit tests

HD FULL download: four slots of the SD FULL shape (L2-5), the bench exercises the HD PREVIEW four-quadrant product (L2-10); ZOOM not run on the bench; Memory Status and camera-side parameter errors are not available on this hardware (SDD §Hardware notes); rejected HD slot (REQ-035) unit-tested only
REQ-017 second DOWNLOAD_ABORT while an abort is pending (BUSY): window is one line exchange (≤ ~75 ms; 2–33 ms observed), bench command spacing ≥ 0.6 s; unit-tested
coverage.rationale: UT baseline 95: the host build forces every error branch; on-target floor 65 reflects the not_covered_ack list: camera-side faults (timeout, 0xFF on most commands, send failure, stray/power-on bytes, queue overflow) cannot be forced on this bench without power control or a fault injector, so the reachable on-target maximum is about 68 % of SunCamMgr.cpp lines.

image_version.reason: SunCamRef includes Svc.Version; L0-1 compares the FrameworkVersion/ProjectVersion/LibraryVersions payloads with the manifest describe strings (helper version_matches_manifest)

final_state.accepted_evidence: L7-1: the Image data product written by DpWriter during the L7-1 window. The bench `dump` recipe copies the DpWriter output directory into record/raw/dp/ before `fth hash-record`, so the product files are hashed record; the helper selects the product whose container id is Image and whose header time lies in [t(START), t(END)] of the window (FSW time), FAILs when none exists, decodes ImageHeader + 60 ImageLine records, checks header fields and line order (pattern KAT added at the §7 refresh, decision log 10), and writes dev-evidence/images/L7-1-final.png.
final_state.rationale: The product file is independent of the component's events and channels and is replayable by the auditor from the sealed record; a stale (earlier) product cannot satisfy the window-bound selection, so a uut-state fault drawn on L7-1 FAILs the dump as contract §6 expects.

scope: - UUT: `KissCam.SunCamMgr` (fprime-community/fprime-devices, `fprime-devices/KissCam`), SHA recorded in the manifest at stage 2.

- Deployment: `SunCamRef` in fprime-community/fprime-devices-reference (human-directed test deployment; the repository was empty): CdhCore + ComFprime (TCP to the GDS on the Pi) + DataProducts + FileHandling subtopologies, Svc.Version, Svc.PrmDb, rate groups 1/10 Hz, `uartDriver: Drv.PosixUartDriver` on /dev/ttyUSB0 115200 8N1, `sunCamMgr: KissCam.SunCamMgr` driven by the 10 Hz rate group.

- Bench: Raspberry Pi 5 `devin` (aarch64, Debian), KissCAM V2 bench unit powered on, FTDI USB-RS422 cable FTAQMGVF → /dev/ttyUSB0; foreign /dev/ttyACM1-3 never touched; no software power control (the camera's USB power port cannot be switched; human power cycle in L8-1 only).
- Camera counters (RXV, RXF, uptime) persist across FSW restarts and runs — never asserted absolutely, only as deltas (mod 256) or ignored.
- Ground system: fprime-gds (harness skill default); recorder fprime-cli events/channels.
- Order: L0-1, L0-2, L2-1 … L2-10, L2-11, L3-1, L5-1, L5-3, L6-1, L6-2, L7-1, L8-1; every `setup` names the state the previous test leaves.
- L8-1 is the one human-in-the-loop test (`run_in: ["rfr"]`, `human_step`): deferred in dry runs and rehearsal, executed only in the run-for-record with the human step prompted by the runner.

- Out of scope: WRITE_REGISTER (excluded by the request), camera power sequencing, HD FULL download on the bench (1920 lines, 4 × L2-5), datasheet features the unit does not implement (Memory Status, 80×60 preview, camera-side parameter errors — SDD §Hardware notes), downlink of products (DpCatalog/FileDownlink are deployment services).
entry_gates: - Stage-1 close: `fprime-util check` on `KissCam/Components/SunCamMgr` passes with every row of the SDD unit-test list implemented.

- Image: `SunCamRef` built for aarch64 from the manifest SHAs (fprime-devices, fprime, fprime-devices-reference, harness) with Svc.Version strings; installed on the Pi by the bench `flash` script; dictionary from that build.

- Marker round-trip: `cmdDisp.CMD_NO_OP_STRING` → `NoOpStringReceived` (format `Received a NO-OP string={}`, CmdDispatcher.fpp) byte-exact in the record (L0-2); event budget ≤ 60 events per test window.

- Bench recipe: `bench.json` (flash = install + restart SunCamRef by recorded PID; dump = copy of the running binary + copy of the DpWriter output directory into record/raw/dp/; reset = restart by recorded PID, settle ≥ 3 s; gds/recorder/send via fprime-gds + fprime-cli on the Pi); `/dev/ttyUSB0` held by no other process.
- Camera precondition: powered on, idle; L2-1 SETUP_CAMERA establishes READY — no test assumes a prior camera state except as its `setup` says.

- §7 refresh at stage 2 confirms on the bench: event text/enum rendering against the SunCamRef dictionary; slot memory intact across a mode change (L2-9); HD capture duration and the 192-line HD preview product (L2-10); HD download reply mode byte 03 → header imageMode HD; all four slots re-captured in SD after the HD capture (L2-10); download durations (L2-4/L2-5).
levels: L0 provenance/feasibility · L2 functional · L3 persistence/reset · L5 fault paths · L6 negative controls · L7 final state for independent verification · L8 human-in-the-loop (run-for-record only).
metrics_note: numeric thresholds live in each test's metrics[]; nominal DOWNLOAD PREVIEW ≤ 10 s, FULL ≤ 90 s (115200 baud: 480 × 648 B ≈ 27 s + camera latency, 3× margin; §7.4.6 reply = 6 framing + 2 line-number + 640/64 pixel bytes).
not_covered: - REQ-004/016/018 (timeout, failed set-up step, failed line), REQ-020 (stray bytes, power-on line — SDD §Hardware notes), REQ-021 (mode mismatch), REQ-034 (camera restart while READY: needs a camera power cycle), REQ-024 (send/allocation failure), REQ-028 (readback mismatch), REQ-029 (queue full): no plantable mechanism on this bench (no power control, no fault injector, no second bus writer) — unit tests.

- HD FULL download: four slots of the same 480-line shape as SD FULL (L2-5), 1920 lines ≈ 2 min; the bench exercises the HD PREVIEW four-quadrant product (L2-10). ZOOM mode: framing identical to SD, not run on the bench (the FOV crop is the camera's). Memory Status and camera-side parameter errors are not available on this hardware (SDD §Hardware notes) and are not tested. A rejected HD slot (REQ-035) is unit-tested only. Camera error reply (REQ-019): no documented command this unit answers with an error reply (SDD §Hardware notes, Camera-side parameter validation), so REQ-019 is Unit Test only and has no bench test.
